title: Crystal Palace Sack Pierre Sage: Quick Trigger, Bigger Test
body:
Crystal Palace have moved on from Pierre Sage after just 16 matches in charge [S1]. The decision came with the club bottom of the table [S2].

BBC Sport framed it the same way, as a sacking after 16 games [S2]. Sky Sports led with the same bare fact [S1]. The basics are not in dispute, so the real argument is about what comes next, not whether the call was made.

The form explains the frustration. In their last five league matches, Crystal Palace have won once, lost four, taken 3 points, scored 4 and conceded 13 [ST1]. The sequence reads WLLLL [ST1]. A side shipping that many goals with that little return was always going to have a nervous dugout.

The sack is the easiest lever to pull and the hardest one to pull well. The next appointment matters far more than the timing of this one. A rushed hire after a rushed sacking is how a bad run turns into a bad season.

The Touchline Take: get the next appointment right and this is forgotten.
